basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Purba Medinipur Cluster Programme Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One contractual post of Cluster Programme Manager (CPM) under DISHA (UR – 1) is open at the DISHA Unit, Purba Medinipur, under NACP of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purba Medinipur District will engage the post-holder purely on a contractual basis up to 31.03.2027 at Rs.54,300.00 per month. Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Medical or allied health Sciences or a Master's degree in one of the listed fields, with three or five years' experience. They must apply online on the Department's website from 4 Nove

important_dates.interview_date: To be published on the website

how_to_apply: Only online applications will be accepted. The notice gives these steps:
Apply online in the prescribed format given on the Department's website between 4 November 2026 and midnight of 26 November 2026.
Complete registration and pay the fee online by 25 November 2026: Rs.100/- for General categories and Rs.50/- for Reserve categories. The fee is non-refundable.
Upload a proper signature and photograph with the online application; otherwise the application will be cancelled.
Complete the full submission of the application form by midnight of 26 November 2026.

Download the print copy of the online registration form from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx -> "Application Print" and keep it for document verification. Without it, a candidate will not be entertained for verification of original testimonials.
Keep the online registration number for future reference; the employer is not liable to give any information about it later.
The hard copy or print copy of the online registration form does not need to be sent by post.
Experience Certificate from the appointing authority (with the details listed above)
Caste Certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal (wherever applicable)
Print copy of the online registration form
important_instructions: Application forms not properly filled in or incomplete are liable to be cancelled. If the online application details differ from the original testimonials, the application is liable to be cancelled. Duplicate applications will be summarily rejected. No document can be added during verification except those marked "Applied for" in the application; such candidates will be rejected if the document is not produced in original during verification. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for the subsequent stages. The competent authorities may cancel the recruitment process at any stage, and their decision regarding the recruitment is final. Any corrigendum or addendum will be published on http://www.wbhealth.gov.in and http://www.purbamedinipur.gov.in.

Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal

Maximum 50 years as on closing date of receipt of application
Midnight of 26 November 2026 (registration and fee payment by 25 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: About Purba Medinipur Health Samiti
content_sections.text: The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Purba Medinipur District is a registered society (Registration No. S/IL/10904 of 2002 – 2003) based at Tamluk, Purba Medinipur, PIN – 721636. The notice is issued by Dr. Bibhash Roy, CMOH & Secretary of the Samiti. The post is engaged under NACP, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, and is posted at the DISHA Unit, Purba Medinipur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: Bachelor's degree in Medical or allied health Sciences / Master's degree in Public Health / Health Care Management / Health Care Administration / Social Science / Psychology / Applied epidemiology / Demography / Statistics / Population Sciences or similar fields. Experience , as printed in the notice: Three years' experience for candidates with Master's degree in Public Health / Health Care Management / Health Care Administration / Applied Epidemiology. Five years' experience in Public Health for Bachelor's degree in Medical or allied Sciences / Masters in Social Science / Psychology / Demography / Statistics / Population Sciences including a minimum 2 years of experience in HIV/AIDS sector. Work experience in HIV / AIDS sector, especially in Programme Management at National / State level, should be given more weightage in the experience section than other public health experience. How experience is counted: Experience is calculated after obtaining the required essential qualification, up to the first date of online application. Experience gained while pursuing the course will not be counted. Ph.D/ M.Phil will not be included in the experience period (wherever applicable). The Experience Certificate must come from the appointing authority and mention designation, date of joining, tenure, date of resignation/retirement (if applicable) and nature of activities. An offer or joining letter will not be considered. Experience certificates not fulfilling these criteria will be summarily rejected. Age limit: Maximum 50 years as on the closing date of receipt of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Other conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages. All essential qualifications must be completed on or before the first date of online application. Caste Certificate issued on or before the first date of online application, by the competent authorities of West Bengal only, will be accepted (wherever applicable). The essential criteria are the minimum; merely possessing them does not entitle a candidate to claim selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration for the Cluster Programme Manager (CPM) under DISHA is Rs.54,300.00 / Month. The post is purely contractual, with an initial period up to 31.03.2027. The notice says the engagement is likely to be extended on satisfactory performance and approval of Govt., and that the tenure may be renewed on the basis of satisfactory performance and approval of the state authority.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Purba Medinipur Health Samiti Cluster Programme Manager (CPM) under DISHA
content_sections.text: Only online applications will be accepted. The notice gives these steps: Apply online in the prescribed format given on the Department's website between 4 November 2026 and midnight of 26 November 2026. Complete registration and pay the fee online by 25 November 2026: Rs.100/- for General categories and Rs.50/- for Reserve categories. The fee is non-refundable. Upload a proper signature and photograph with the online application; otherwise the application will be cancelled. Complete the full submission of the application form by midnight of 26 November 2026. Download the print copy of the online registration form from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx -> "Application Print" and keep it for document verification. Without it, a candidate will not be entertained for verification of original testimonials. Keep the online registration number for future reference; the employer is not liable to give any information about it later. The hard copy or print copy of the online registration form does not need to be sent by post. Documents named in the notice: Experience Certificate from the appointing authority (with the details listed above) Caste Certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal (wherever applicable) Print copy of the online registration form Original testimonials for verification

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection follows a Scale of Scoring with a maximum of 100 marks: All marks are calculated excluding marks of Additional Subject. There is no rounding off of marks; proportionate marking up to 2 decimal points will be considered. Eligible candidates must go through all stages of recruitment, and a candidate who skips any stage will be disqualified. The date, time and venue of the interview, and the shortlisting of candidates, will be published on http://www.wbhealth.gov.in and http://www.purbamedinipur.gov.in .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for Cluster Programme Manager (CPM) under DISHA?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, reserved as UR – 1, posted at the DISHA Unit, Purba Medinipur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The full application must be submitted by midnight of 26 November 2026, while registration and fee payment close on 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Medical or allied health Sciences or a Master's degree in Public Health / Health Care Management / Health Care Administration / Social Science / Psychology / Applied epidemiology / Demography / Statistics / Population Sciences or similar fields, with three or five years' experience as specified.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs.54,300.00 / Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/- for General categories and Rs.50/- for Reserve categories, paid online only and non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed format on the Department's website from 4 November 2026 to midnight of 26 November 2026, and keep the print copy from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx -> "Application Print" for verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is out of 100 marks: Written Test – 50, Experience – 20 and Physical Interview including computer test – 30.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely contractual with an initial period up to 31.03.2027, likely to be extended on satisfactory performance and approval of Govt.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply?
faq.answer: No. The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages.
